title: China says it can 'easily win' a confrontation with the Philippines
detail: Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan told reporters in Manila on Oct 15 that 'if we want to use force, we may easily win', while adding that China 'will not choose force' and 'loves peace'. The Philippine foreign ministry called the wording 'regrettable' and a thinly veiled threat of force; PCG spokesman Jay Tarriela called it a 'direct threat'. Jing also warned of greater confrontation risk unless direct military-to-military channels, suspended for about three years, are restored, and dismissed Defense Secretary Teodoro's 'troublemaker' label as 'nonsense'.

media.caption: China says it can 'easily win' confrontation with Philippines
